title: BCC Ruling No. 18-07-1503 — basement ceiling height below bulkheads
code_edition: Ontario Building Code 2012, O. Reg. 332/12 (as cited)

facts.text: The application concerns a finished basement in an existing two-storey detached dwelling at 906 Wrenwood Drive, Oshawa.
The record gives 2,100 mm over at least 75% of the basement and 1,910–1,970 mm below finished bulkheads containing pre-existing ducts and beams.
The cited provisions are Article 9.5.3.1. and Table 9.5.3.1.; the hallway immediately before the exit stairs is described as 2,100 mm high.
